description: This file defines utility functions for the Spark Streaming UI, including time unit conversions, duration normalization, and failure message formatting.

methods.name: shortTimeUnitString
methods.description: Returns a short string representation for a given TimeUnit.

methods.name: normalizeDuration
methods.description: Finds the most appropriate TimeUnit for a duration in milliseconds and returns the value with that unit.

methods.name: convertToTimeUnit
methods.description: Converts milliseconds to a specified TimeUnit, including fractional parts.

methods.name: createOutputOperationFailureForUI
methods.description: Formats failure messages for display in the UI, adding context based on the failure string.

methods.name: failureReasonCell
methods.description: Generates an XML table cell node displaying failure reason summary and details.
